title: Policy array does not prune partitions (16 vs 128 hash partitions)
issue: org_id = ANY(InitPlan array) is not a plan-time constant and the sublink is never pulled up into a join, so every partition is opened; cost grows with partition count (planning + per-partition scan startup).
symptom: naive/best_practice RLS: Append over all partitions (16 or 128), planning time and exec time grow with partition count for a small tenant, while a literal IN on the parent prunes. The baseline semi-join can prune at run time.

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.documents_p16 and app.documents_p128 (100 docs per org, scale/20 users).
